paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -2.38% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.71%) and Nasdaq weakest (-5.28%). Brent crude changed -2.29% to 89.87. Gold changed -3.98% to 3,539.0. Bitcoin changed -4.52% to 59,103.6719. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -2.77%. Among the firms tracked, Goldman Sachs (-6.71%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-6.37%) moved the most.
